description: Liste des points d'accès WIFI publics et gratuits de la Ville de Lisieux is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Lisieux. The City of Lisieux deploys a territorial network of public and free WiFi access points. In order to simplify its use, the authentication of visitors is unique across all access points and the operation is identical on all sites. The dataset offers the GPS coordinates of each point. Coverage: Ville de Lisieux. The portal shows the English title as "List of public and free WIFI access points in the City of Lisieux" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Lisieux. Its keywords include wifi-territorial, wifi-lisieux, wifi, wifi-public. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2019-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
